notes: The part list is only for the -6 variant.

gaps: The parts web page lists most of the same part numbers under shorter names (it shows the thermostat as WPF29R-103-022) but has no capacitor row, only the capacitor bracket.
The part list gives no compressor voltage; the indicator lamp is the only part with a stated voltage (115 V), and neither it nor the capacitor is marked AC, so no ac flag is set.
No interior lamp or lid switch is listed; not a stated absence, so those template parts are left alone.
method: Danby 7.2 cu. ft. chest freezer; danby.com's product page says the product has been discontinued.

Main source is Danby's own schematic / part list spreadsheet (XLSX, linked as 'Schematic / Part List' from the Danby Appliance Parts page): factory model BD-198A, effective date 23 Aug 2019, revision 00; column C holds 'Updated Part Number, May 2021', given here as 'now ...'.
Read from the spreadsheet cells on 2026-11-12.
The product spec PDF names R600a refrigerant.
Ext/obs on extra parts are editorial.
The same Energy Guide covers DCF072A3BDB, DCF072A3WDB, DCF072A3WDB-3 and DCF072A3WDB-6.

comps.spec: Compressor EZ59E1C; Danby part 1.03.01.01.194 (now 1.03.01.01.598), qty 1; four compressor sleeves CTE943-2 listed with it
Capacitor, CBB65 type, 8.0 uF / 250 V; Danby part 1.03.01.01.194C; capacitor bracket 3.5.2.01.0793
Green indicator lamp, 115 V (HNXD1); Danby part 1.01.03.01.064R
Power supply cord assembly, listed as E465601 or E215500 or E313201; Danby part 1.01.01.01.220R
Manual-defrost chest cabinet, capacity 7.2 cu. ft.; Energy Guide estimate 252 kWh per year
